ph-2IcS.title: Road: very wide, six lanes, little traffic
ph-2IcS.summary: A very wide highway, often six lanes, with very little traffic, and a double electrical wire along it. It leads south from a western island city.

ph-2cMP.title: Plants: banana plantations in the south
ph-2cMP.summary: Banana plantations are almost only in the centre and south of the big southern island. Wild bananas grow everywhere, so check it is a real plantation.

ph-2ctB.title: Plants: oil palm plantations in the south
ph-2ctB.summary: Most oil palm plantations are on the big southern island.

ph-2hW1.title: Pole: octagonal metal poles
ph-2hW1.summary: Octagonal metal poles are quite common. They sometimes appear in Bangladesh and parts of Malaysia.

ph-3TK5.title: Plate: motorcycle colour strip shows region
ph-3TK5.summary: Motorcycle plates have a coloured strip that depends on the region. In the northern half the strip is at the top, in the southern half at the bottom.

ph-40U4.title: Landscape: dry pine mountains in the north
ph-40U4.summary: In the north: forested mountains with somewhat dry slopes and many pine trees. You may rarely see this on high roads in the far south island.

ph-9hUv.title: Plants: corn, mostly in the north and far south
ph-9hUv.summary: Corn grows in most of the country but is most common in the far north island and the big southern island.

ph-9xJp.title: Google car: black with roof rack
ph-9xJp.summary: A black car with a visible roof rack, in and around one southern city.

ph-A2hm.title: Landmark: Roman soldier statues
ph-A2hm.summary: Images and statues of ancient Roman soldiers, on one small island south of the main northern island.

ph-AvQg.title: Landscape: lone volcano among flat fields
ph-AvQg.summary: A volcano completely surrounded by flat farmland.

ph-DIih.title: Chevron: red on white
ph-DIih.summary: Curve chevrons are red on white.

ph-GaHP.title: Plants: sugarcane on two central islands
ph-GaHP.summary: Most sugarcane is on two islands in the centre-west.

ph-H99u.title: Region: majority Muslim area in the south-west
ph-H99u.summary: Most of the country is strongly Christian, but a region of the south-west is mostly Muslim.

ph-IPDO.title: Road lines: mixed yellow and white centre, orange tint
ph-IPDO.summary: Centre lines can be yellow or white, and often yellow and white together, which no other East Asian country does. Yellow lines often look orange.

ph-Js5k.title: Houses: destroyed buildings and ruins
ph-Js5k.summary: Many destroyed houses and ruins from a siege in 2017, in and around one southern city.

ph-KVEg.title: Sign: province names
ph-KVEg.summary: Province names are common on signs and very useful, but they are not on the map, so you must learn them. One province was renamed in 2019.

ph-LrWc.title: Landmark: large decorated white waystones
ph-LrWc.summary: Large decorated white waystones for a World War II death march, along roads from the south to the north of one peninsula. A bigger memorial is further north.

ph-NKYi.title: Language: lots of English signs
ph-NKYi.summary: English is extremely common on signs next to the local language. It is the only major Southeast Asian country where you are likely to see so much English.

ph-OkTN.title: Pole: square concrete with indented sides
ph-OkTN.summary: Square concrete poles with an indent on both sides, like Chile's. Mainly north of the capital and around one central island city.

ph-QPqh.title: Pole: black or white box with three letters
ph-QPqh.summary: Black or white boxes on poles show a three-letter code for the town: either all three letters, or two for the town and one for the province. Many towns have no standard code.

ph-Qhbg.title: Google car: white with visible black roof (older camera)
ph-Qhbg.summary: In older Gen 3 coverage (blurrier, softer colours): a white car with a clearly visible black roof. A silvery grey car also appears, which Bhutan has too.

differs.how: Bhutan also has a silvery grey car

ph-S1IY.title: Landscape: round grassy hills over brown soil
ph-S1IY.summary: In the centre: distinct round grassy hills with dark brown soil underneath.

ph-SJtk.title: Plate: white with black text, green tint on old ones
ph-SJtk.summary: Passenger cars have white plates with black text. Many older plates (the 2002 series) have a green tint.

ph-XOvY.title: Houses: woven bamboo walls, diagonal pattern
ph-XOvY.summary: Woven bamboo walls with a diagonal weave are mostly on one western island but also across the northern half.

ph-YkcX.title: Plants: pale-trunk trees with feathery tops
ph-YkcX.summary: Trees with light-coloured trunks and feathery leaves near the top. Mostly on the big southern island, especially the east and centre.

ph-ZiXa.title: Houses: woven bamboo walls with diamond pattern
ph-ZiXa.summary: Houses with woven bamboo-mat walls in a diamond pattern are almost only in the southern half.

ph-aUOw.title: Sign: red, orange or yellow signposts
ph-aUOw.summary: Signposts are often painted red, orange or yellow.

ph-cmeG.title: Vehicle: tricycles everywhere
ph-cmeG.summary: Three-wheeled tuk-tuks (tricycles) are extremely common, often more than cars.

ph-dWWI.title: Vehicle: improvised farm tractor
ph-dWWI.summary: A homemade-looking tractor called a kuliglig, mostly on the plains of the north.

ph-f897.title: Phone numbers: landline 0 + area code, mobile 09
ph-f897.summary: Landlines start with 0 then an area code. Mobile numbers start with 09.

ph-fCvm.title: Vehicle: tricycle designs vary by region
ph-fCvm.summary: Several different tricycle designs are spread across the country, as shown in the map.

ph-jvOq.title: Vehicle: thick black bars
ph-jvOq.summary: A vehicle with several thick black bars, seen just south of a famous volcano.

ph-lS7l.title: Plants: pineapple plantations in the south
ph-lS7l.summary: Pineapple plantations are mostly on the big southern island.

ph-lYvE.title: Pole: yellow lamp posts with black stripes
ph-lYvE.summary: Lamp posts painted yellow with black stripes at the bottom, on one small central island.

ph-leAL.title: Pole: single insulator on a side bar
ph-leAL.summary: A single insulator on the top of a vertical bar attached to the side of the pole.

ph-lm-151.title: Road: concrete and right-hand traffic
ph-lm-151.summary: In Southeast Asia, concrete roads mean mostly here or Thailand, rarely Indonesia. Right-hand traffic means it is here; left-hand means Thailand or Indonesia.

differs.how: Thailand also has concrete roads but drives on the left
Indonesia also drives on the left

ph-lm-3091.title: Google car: silver truck with roof rack (old coverage)
ph-lm-3091.summary: In the far south, some old leftover coverage was shot with a silver truck with a roof rack. It runs alongside newer Gen 4 photos of the same roads.

ph-lm-3642.title: Pole: four stacked disc insulators
ph-lm-3642.summary: Four stacked pancake-shaped insulators on a pole top mean the single covered coastal road in the far south-east.

ph-lm-3643.title: Pole: two stacked disc insulators
ph-lm-3643.summary: Double pancake insulators are very rare but most likely along the east coast of one eastern island.

ph-lm-3644.title: Pole: thick insulator stem
ph-lm-3644.summary: The stems under the insulators on pole tops are thick or wrapped in plastic tube, making them look thicker than normal. It is common on one central island.

ph-lm-3889.title: Pole: three ridges and a long extender
ph-lm-3889.summary: An insulator with three ridges plus a long extender at the top to hold the wire. Most common in the north-west of two eastern central islands.

ph-lm-3890.title: Pole: grey solid insulator with many small ridges
ph-lm-3890.summary: A grey insulator with lots of small ridges that looks almost solid. Most common around the capital, rare elsewhere.

ph-lm-3891.title: Pole: insulator shaped like desert-planet buildings
ph-lm-3891.summary: An insulator that looks like the buildings on a sci-fi desert planet. Most common in the north and around the capital.

ph-lm-3892.title: Pole: cylinder insulator with four ridges
ph-lm-3892.summary: A cylinder with four clear ridges. Most common in the far north-west, but also found in the south of one eastern island.

ph-lm-6328.title: Road: grey guard blocks with yellow edges
ph-lm-6328.summary: Grey concrete guard blocks with yellow edges or sides, in the north of one central island. Other block styles exist there too, like fully yellow ones or diagonal black-yellow stripes.

ph-lm-6329.title: Pole: electric meters on yellow boards
ph-lm-6329.summary: Electricity meters on yellow backboards, horizontal or vertical, metal or wood. Found on two neighbouring islands in the centre-west.

ph-lm-6330.title: Vehicle: tricycle with single wide front window
ph-lm-6330.summary: Tricycles with one wide front window, many looking like small cars with emblems. Found on one long western island.

ph-lm-6331.title: Road: sloped concrete blocks with round stone spots
ph-lm-6331.summary: Sloped concrete blocks covered in round spots made of small stones. Straight-edged or non-spotted blocks exist elsewhere, but this combination is only in the southern peninsula of one eastern province.

ph-lm-6337.title: Road: alternating red and blue guard blocks
ph-lm-6337.summary: Alternating red and blue guard blocks in a small area on the narrow neck of one eastern province.

ph-lm-681940.title: Vehicle: tricycle with airplane-window, tilted roof
ph-lm-681940.summary: A tricycle with an airplane-style passenger window, a roof leaning back, and the body bulging out under the window. From behind it has one window and bars on top. It is the only kind on one western peninsula.

ph-lm-681979.title: Vehicle: same tricycle, tiny driver window, roof number
ph-lm-681979.summary: The airplane-window tricycle with a tiny window over the driver's side and a big number on the roof. Found in one city on that western peninsula.

ph-lm-681981.title: Waystone: K and a number for distance
ph-lm-681981.summary: Waystones with K and a number show the distance from the capital, so you can narrow guesses. Some islands never exceed certain numbers, and numbers above 1000 only occur on the big southern island.

ph-lm-681983.title: Vehicle: same tricycle, bubbly numbers on top
ph-lm-681983.summary: The airplane-window tricycle with bubbly numbers on top of the driver's window, in any colour. Found in one city and its surroundings.

ph-lm-681984.title: Vehicle: colourful tricycle, flat roof, white line
ph-lm-681984.summary: A very colourful tricycle with a flat roof, a white line between passenger and driver, and a small bumper under the window. Less colourful versions with a black cloth roof are found north-east of the main city.

ph-lm-681986.title: Vehicle: tricycle with square roof
ph-lm-681986.summary: Tricycles with a square roof are common in one south-western province.

ph-lm-681987.title: Vehicle: tricycle with big flat black roof
ph-lm-681987.summary: Tricycles with a large flat black roof, a small side window and no lines in the main window, mainly in one southern province.

ph-lm-681988.title: Vehicle: green tricycle with blue text
ph-lm-681988.summary: Green tricycles with blue town-centre text, in one small town. Same shape as the big flat black roof type.

ph-lm-681989.title: Vehicle: colourful tricycle with a number on top
ph-lm-681989.summary: A colourful version of the big flat black roof tricycle with a number on top, in one city.

ph-lm-84219.title: Vehicle: tricycle with umbrella
ph-lm-84219.summary: Tricycles with an umbrella are very common in the south-west, and in one city they are the only kind. They are also very common on one central island.

ph-lm-84220.title: Vehicle: tricycle with two-part crown roof
ph-lm-84220.summary: Tricycles with a crown roof made of a rectangular part and a crown-shaped part, mostly in the north. Wavy tops elsewhere are not made of two parts.

ph-lm-84221.title: Vehicle: tricycle with flat roof
ph-lm-84221.summary: Flat roofs are mostly in the south. A three-wheeler is probably on the big southern island.

ph-lm-84223.title: Vehicle: tricycle with low roof
ph-lm-84223.summary: Low-roof tricycles are generally found in the north.

ph-o4Or.title: Google car: orange with visible side mirrors
ph-o4Or.summary: An orange car with visible side mirrors, on a small island at the mouth of a bay.

ph-oQjn.title: Landscape: smooth cone volcano, often in cloud
ph-oQjn.summary: One of the tallest mountains, with an almost perfect smooth cone shape, but often hidden in clouds.

ph-paH1.title: Driving side: right
ph-paH1.summary: Traffic drives on the right. Within Southeast Asia, Cambodia, Laos, Taiwan and Vietnam also drive on the right.

ph-qKJU.title: Road: concrete is extremely common
ph-qKJU.summary: Concrete roads are everywhere. Thailand also has a lot of them.

ph-qoLR.title: Guardrail: yellow and black striped concrete
ph-qoLR.summary: In the northern mountain region: concrete guardrails with yellow and black stripes.

ph-uStw.title: Road: tall square yellow stones
ph-uStw.summary: Tall square yellow road stones, found only here.

ph-vjQB.title: Pole: ladder-like top of two bars with thin wires
ph-vjQB.summary: Two tall metal bars with L-shaped section joined by several thin wires like a ladder. Unique to the capital area. Similar tops with square bars exist elsewhere, but with at most two wires.

ph-xdvo.title: Pole: square metal mesh
ph-xdvo.summary: Square metal mesh poles on the big southern island, mainly its western peninsula. Elsewhere on the island, highway poles have three hanging insulators.

ph-xgaV.title: Google car: tape on the back
ph-xgaV.summary: A car with tape on the back, in the north-west of one central island.

ph-yIwj.title: Road: grain spread out to dry
ph-yIwj.summary: Grain is somewhat commonly spread out on roads to dry. Vietnam does this too.

ph-yYbQ.title: Guardrail: white with three black stripes
ph-yYbQ.summary: White guardrails with three repeating black stripes, unique to the south-east of the main northern island. Similar rails with more or fewer stripes exist, but three points to this area.

ph-yzp6.title: Decoration: neon-green soda-bottle decorations
ph-yzp6.summary: Decorations made of neon-green soda bottles are common in the north, especially the main northern island.
